Tara (People Ops): Quick drop  a tiny 'Goal Signal' matrix + micro-feedback templates for teams to use during goal-setting and reviews. Copy/paste friendly.

Miguel (Staff Eng): Nice. Can we make the matrix 1 sentence per row so managers can scan?

Tara (People Ops): Yup - kept each row very short. Added 3 micro-templates (OKR one-liner, Evidence line, Peer nudge).

people-ops-bot: Heads up: review window opens in 2 days — see /perf for deadlines.

Tara (People Ops): [GOAL SIGNAL MATRIX]
- Signal: Metric change (what changed) | Evidence: dashboard link or % delta | Confidence: High/Med/Low | Owner: who drove it
- Signal: Anecdote (user quote or postmortem line) | Evidence: chat/PR/meeting note | Confidence: Med | Owner: who can reproduce
- Signal: Delivery (shipped feature) | Evidence: PR/ship link + rollout note | Confidence: High | Owner: ship lead

Why: helps calibrate impact vs. effort during review and makes evidence easy to read in 30s.

[MICRO-TEMPLATES: copy/paste]
1) OKR one-liner (for team doc):
- Obj: [short outcome] — KR1: [metric + target], KR2: [adoption/ship], KR3: [quality guardrail].
Example: Obj: Cut embedding cost at 99p traffic. KR1: lower cost/query by 40%. KR2: caching in prod for 3 services. KR3: p95 latency < 120ms.

2) Evidence line (for self-review / pre-read):
- 'What I shipped': [artifact link] | 'Impact': [metric or user story] | 'Signal': [metric/anecdote/delivery] | 'Confidence': [H/M/L]
Example: 'What I shipped': https://git/repo/pr/123 | Impact: -27% cost on nightly batch | Signal: metric | Confidence: H

3) Peer nudge (one-sentence feedback form):
- Q1: One strength? (<=60 chars)
- Q2: One small improvement? (<=80 chars)
- Q3: Quick help idea? (<=100 chars)
Note: default anonymous, opt-in named.

4) Manager 5-min calibration note (paste into meeting doc):
- Employee / Role / Manager rating (Exceeds/Meets/Needs Growth)
- 1-line evidence (pick 1 Evidence line above)
- Main risk (1 short bullet)
Example: 'Ola / SWE II / Meets. Evidence: https://dash/boards/42 shows 18% cost reduction. Risk: rollout docs incomplete.'

Tara (People Ops): Also adding a tiny checklist for goals: 'Is the KR measurable? Who owns the dashboard? Is success threshold explicit?' Keep these on the OKR doc so calibrators can scan.

Ola (SWE): This is super actionable. Can we add a tiny etiquette note for calibration: 'surface constraints (e.g., blocked by infra) rather than padding ratings'?

Tara (People Ops): Yes  added: 'Call out constraints and unknowns; avoid vague descriptors like "helped a lot" without evidence.'

Miguel (Staff Eng): I'll adapt the examples for infra goals and paste into our eng OKR doc. Thanks!

Tara (People Ops): Great. I'll drop this into the perf kickoff doc and the manager playbook. Ping me if you want a Google Slide version. :sparkles:
